tuning_key.text: Love is key / And striving to be / A positive part of our society
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: True connection begins when you stop trying to prove your place and simply listen for where your warmth is needed. Your striving to belong softens into an offering that weaves you into the fabric around you.

practice.title: Soften the Jaw
practice.instruction: Release the muscles around your mouth and ears so you can physically receive what is actually being offered rather than what you expect to hear.

practice.title: Feel the Gap
practice.instruction: Rest your attention in the physical space between your body and the nearest other thing, letting this interval become a place where mutual arrival is possible.

practice.title: Press Play
practice.instruction: Listen to the Echo audio and let it show you exactly where your imperfect striving already meets the warmth of the larger weave.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Today your broadcast is steadiness in service—CONNECTION flows through you when the systems you tend create space for others to belong. Listen to what your family needs before they name it; your care is a frequency that says *you matter here*.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: CONNECTION today means pricing your offer not just in numbers but in trust—what you broadcast when you listen to what someone actually needs, not what moves fastest. The Field responds when value and integrity travel together.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: Your broadcast today is precision in service of belonging—CONNECTION emerges when the tools you build make it easier for others to show up, to participate, to be heard. Listen to how people *use* what you make; that signal teaches you what matters.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: CONNECTION surfaces in the patterns you surface—today, listen for what the data is *not* saying, and broadcast that silence too. The Field responds when you qualify not just what's true, but what's meaningful.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: Your broadcast is the signal itself—CONNECTION means bringing back not just information, but the *feeling* of where people are gathering, what they're reaching for. Listen deeply to the sources; report what you sense, not just what you see.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: CONNECTION lives in context—today, listen to the *why* beneath each decision you preserve, and broadcast that intent forward. The Field responds when your records carry not just facts, but the warmth of what was meant.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Your broadcast is clarity in service of closeness—CONNECTION means writing so that someone on the other side feels *met* by your words. Listen to the silence between sentences; let that shape what you say.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: CONNECTION is your native frequency—today, broadcast warmth without overreach, listen to what people actually need from you, and let that boundary be an act of care. The Field responds when you show up whole, not stretched.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: Your broadcast is precision that protects—CONNECTION means checking not just for error, but for whether this work honors what it claims to serve. Listen to the tone beneath the words; flag when the broadcast doesn't match the intention.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: CONNECTION surfaces in what you notice and name—today, broadcast the patterns you see without judgment, listen to how they shift, and let the Field know what's becoming real. You are a mirror; mirrors connect.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Your broadcast is presence—CONNECTION means showing up without agenda, listening more than speaking, and letting someone know they are *not alone* in this moment. The Field responds to steady warmth.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: CONNECTION emerges when you ask the question that opens the door—today, broadcast curiosity instead of answers, listen to what's underneath the surface problem, and help name the real shape of what needs attention.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Your broadcast is structure in service of vision—CONNECTION means taking scattered pieces and showing how they belong together. Listen to how each part wants to fit; the Field responds when the design honors what it holds.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: CONNECTION is your steadiness—today, broadcast that you will not flinch, listen to what's heavy without turning away, and let the Field know it can rest here. Your presence is a frequency that says *this is safe*.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: Your broadcast is direction without force—CONNECTION means reading the signs and holding the big picture so others can trust the course. Listen to where things are aligning; the Field responds when you notice and name the path forward.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: CONNECTION ignites when you play with possibility—today, broadcast wonder, listen to what excites people, and let the Field know that growth and joy belong together. Your frequency opens what felt closed.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: Your broadcast is faith in what someone can become—CONNECTION means pushing because you see the potential, listening to their resistance as data, not rejection. The Field responds when you dare them to grow.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: CONNECTION is your presence—today, broadcast that you are here, listen without rushing to fix, and let someone know their experience *matters* simply because you're holding it with them. Quiet steadiness is a frequency too.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Your broadcast turns intention into motion—CONNECTION means listening to what's stuck, then broadcasting the spark that gets things moving again. The Field responds when you break stagnation and show the next concrete step.
